attributes.name: TeamSpeak 3 Server
attributes.description: Download server files from https://teamspeak.com/en/downloads/#server (Server amd64 Linux -> tar.bz2) via Files > Download from URL. Self-extracts on first boot; grab the privileged keys from console log.
attributes.startup: [ -x ts3server ] || (tar xjf {{ARCHIVE}} --strip-components=1 && chmod +x ts3server); ./ts3server license_accepted=1 default_voice_port={{SERVER_PORT}}
